units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:16">Targ. Is. XLIV, 16</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="I00152"><he>טְוָה</he></cite>); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="I00153"><he>טָוֵי</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="I00153"><he>טְוֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:12">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>נִיטַוְויֵיה וכ׳</he> let him roast it in a smithy; a. fr.
<cite ref="Beitzah 4a">Bets. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>מהו לאַטְוִוינְהוּ וכ׳</he> is it permitted to roast them to-day &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 76b:10">Pes. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>דאִיטְּוָוא וכ׳</he> which was roasted together with meat.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 19b:19">B. Kam. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>דמִטְּוֵוי</he> (Ar. <he>בטָוִוי</he>) it means that it was roasted.
